headline: OpenAI's gpt-6-astra makes a dramatic 15-spot jump
summary: OpenAI's gpt-6-astra-20260903 vaulted 15 ranks in a single day to land at #12, riding a 0.013 percentage-point surge. Meanwhile, stealth/space-bunny-alpha holds firm at the top with 22.0% share, while DeepSeek consolidates second place at 22.4%. One model exited the leaderboard entirely: upstage/solar-pro4-20260810 dropped out after holding rank 24.
